Emily — thanks for the redline and the clear asks. Looping in Lauren (Finance) and Karthik (Legal) to get the billing/tax and contract items nailed down. Quick summary from our side:

- Invoice routing: we can send invoices to invoices@acme-payments.com and will populate the PO number in the "Invoice Reference" field if you provide the PO. We can split invoices between the recurring subscription line and usage/overage lines.
- Taxes: typically we require either a valid VAT ID (for EU entities) or W-8BEN-E/W-9 for US/non-US tax residency. If ACME wants to reverse-charge VAT, we need your VAT certificates on file.

I’m attaching our standard payment schedule and an example split invoice layout so your AP team can confirm it matches their requirements.

Next steps: Lauren/Karthik — can you confirm (1) net terms options (we generally support Net 30/45 for ACME-sized deployments), (2) any minimum upfront for orders > $250k, and (3) whether the redline has any legal blockers that would slow signature?

Markus Klein

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Order form redline + invoice routing question


Hi all — quick finance note to make sure AP can process without delay:

1) Net terms & credit: For ACME we can offer Net 45 for the initial term subject to credit approval. For deals where the committed ARR across the year exceeds $250,000 we typically require either (a) 30% upfront on signing or (b) a short-term escrow/advance schedule. If ACME prefers Net 30 we can consider it with a small processing fee (0.5% of first invoice) — let me know.

2) Invoice splitting: We will issue one invoice per billing period that itemizes the subscription fee and a separate line for usage/overages. If ACME needs a separate physical invoice file per line item we can accommodate but it will create multiple invoice records. Most customers accept one file with line-item breakdown.

3) Tax evidence: For US entities we need a completed W-9. For non-US entities we need W-8BEN-E plus local VAT registration evidence (EU VAT ID). If you will reverse-charge VAT, supply the VAT ID and a signed self-certification from your tax team.

4) PO and invoice address: please confirm the exact PO number format and whether invoices@acme-payments.com should be in To or CC. Also confirm the legal invoice address (billing address) for any tax compliance.

Cc’ing Ben for sales alignment (billing contact) and Karthik for legal redline commentary.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Emily / ACME team — looping back with legal confirmation and a proposed path to signature: 

- Billing / invoice routing: confirmed — we will send invoices to invoices@acme-payments.com with PO# 8362 in the reference. For the first two billing cycles we will emit two separate invoices (subscription commit + onboarding services) as requested.
- Net terms / credit: Net 45 subject to credit signoff. Because the total contracted value exceeds $250k, Redwood requests 30% of first-year committed ARR on signing or a signed alternative payment schedule. If ACME cannot provide 30% upfront we can accept Net 45 with an internal credit hold and a short-term payment guarantee (email confirmation from finance).
- Taxes: Redwood will assess and charge VAT/sales tax where applicable unless ACME provides documentation for reverse charge (EU VAT IDs + certificate). For US withholding issues we will accept W-9/W-8 forms. Please upload tax evidence to the secure SFTP link we will provide (I can share a one-time upload link).
- Docs & signature: There are two small commercial redlines in the Order Form (payment milestones and tax clause) that we can resolve by adding a paragraph in Section 3 that documents the payment split and PO requirement. If that is acceptable to ACME, I’ll prepare the final Order Form and send for signature via DocuSign.

Proposed next actions:
1) ACME to send W-9 + VAT certificate and confirm PO routing (done).
2) ACME to confirm decision on 30% upfront vs. Net 45 with payment guarantee by EOD Wed.
3) If confirmed, I will upload final Order Form to DocuSign and share the envelope link.

If you want a quick call to close this, Ben and I are available tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,
